title: Publish a TypeScript library to npm
problem: Shipping a TypeScript library means an exports map, ESM and CJS builds, and a declaration pass that all have to agree, and every one of them is hand-maintained until it silently stops matching what was emitted.
outcome: A packed, installable package built from one source file, whose exports map, main/module/types fields and files allowlist were synthesized from what the build produced, proven from both `import` and `require`.

knowledge: An empty directory to build the library in
An npm account, for the last step only
